news.summary: A five-year SEC order lets tokenized shares with full rights trade on public blockchains without stock-exchange registration; Solana's architecture is live.
news.title: Stocks Go Onchain: What the SEC's Innovation Exemption Means for Solana

news.summary: Project Harmonia connects Allfunds, with about €1.9 trillion under administration, to tokenized funds on Solana; submissions close October 24, 2026.
news.title: Project Harmonia Brings Institutional Tokenized Funds to Solana

news.summary: New report on stablecoin remittances covering four implementation paths for money transfer operators, corridor overviews, and case studies.
news.title: Report: Stablecoins Are Reshaping Remittances

news.summary: The Solana Foundation appointed Rachel Conlan to lead strategy and Jamal Raees to expand global payments adoption.
news.title: Solana Foundation Appoints Rachel Conlan as Chief Strategy Officer and Jamal Raees as General Manager of Payments

news.summary: V1 transaction activation is delayed to Epoch 1035, alongside new Agave, Firedancer, Web3.js, Solana Kit, and program releases.
news.title: Solana Changelog: September 10, 2026

news.summary: Firedancer adopts three RPC calls and advances ARM support, while three mainnet feature gates and new Agave, Web3.js, and Solana Kit versions land.
news.title: Solana Changelog: September 3, 2026

news.summary: Transaction V1 reaches mainnet as Solana targets 250ms slots, lower rent, and program deployments with four times lower fees.
news.title: Solana Changelog: September 18, 2026

news.summary: A ~$116 million Coldcard exploit shows why crypto security must eliminate single points of failure and automate defenses for AI-speed threats.
news.title: How AI Is Reshaping Crypto Security, with Michael Coates

news.summary: A look back at Solana Summer School 2026: 1,164 applicants from 69 countries, five weeks of live classes, four weeks of capstone building, and one demo day.
news.title: Solana Summer School 2026: From first program to demo day

news.summary: Solana has maintained 100% uptime since February 2024, including when a routing failure took nearly 29% of network stake offline.
news.title: Solana: Building, Proving and Earning Trust in Public

news.summary: BitRobot open-sourced 2,000 hours of robot navigation data and uses Solana to track and reward embodied AI data contributors.
news.title: How BitRobot Crowdsources Real-World Data for Embodied AI, with Jonathan Victor

news.summary: Solana’s August 2026 roundup: record transactions, $4B in RWAs, growing stablecoin payments, tokenized stocks, DeFi innovation, ETFs, and governance.
news.title: Solana Ecosystem Roundup: August 2026
